question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e. **'Far-flung'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5 is 1) **"far-flung".**
 
• The term **"far-flung"** is used to describe places that are a great distance away or are very spread out.
 
• **In the context** of the sentence, it refers to areas in the new districts that are distant from the district headquarters.
